name: Growing Dread
oracle_text:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, manifest dread. (Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever you turn a permanent face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: When this enchantment enters, manifest dread
Whenever you turn a permanent face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it

needs.what: manifest dread (701.62): look at the top two cards of your library, choose one and manifest it (face-down 2/2, turnable face up for its mana cost if a creature card), put the other into your graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `manifest` op takes only amount, cloak and player and manifests the top card(s) with no choice; it cannot look at two, pick one and send the rest to the graveyard. `look_at_top` can pick and send rest_to graveyard and has face_down, but its face_down does not make a manifested 2/2 that can be turned up for its mana cost, so composing them would be an approximation

needs.what: a trigger event fired when a player turns a permanent face up (the engine already emits `turned_face_up` with player and source in Game._turn_face_up), filterable by the player who turned it (`controller: you`), binding the turned permanent as the subject so an effect can put a +1/+1 counter on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `trigger_events` has no face-up event; `permanent_enters` does not fire on turning face up (the permanent never re-enters), and nothing else in the list observes a face-down permanent becoming face up
